name: sheetview-tilt
label: Real data render
alt: The same sheet in Neuroglancer turned about 35 degrees and tipped, so its left edge looks longer than its right and its gentle bends show.
caption: Real data render: kit sheetview's mesh of PHerc0139 segment w045 in the hosted Neuroglancer, the 2.399 um CT sampled onto its vertices (mean over plus or minus 4 voxels along the normal). CT and mesh geometry, no labels, no ink. Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0.

data.credit: Vesuvius Challenge open data, CC BY-NC 4.0

command: python scripts/media/sheetview_media.py actions SHEET/state.json --out-dir PLAN && python scripts/media/capture_web.py "$(cat PLAN/url.txt)" --webgl --out-dir SHOTS --actions PLAN/stills.json --width 1600 --height 900 && python scripts/media/sheetview_media.py publish SHOTS --assets docs/assets/sheetview --meta scripts/media/captures/sheetview-orbit.meta.json
